theorem_title: Exact raw-incidence membership of the actual frontier
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostFrontier.mem_frontier_iff {h J k : ℕ} (I : Finset (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawIncidences.RawItem h J α β γ))
    (w : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.Wanted h J α) (hk : k ≤ J) (pre : List (Finset (Fin (464*h)))) :
    pre ∈ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ReportingHostFrontier.frontier I w k ↔ ∃ r ∈ I, _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.wantedOf r = w ∧ (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.RawReporting.word r).take k = pre := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $h,J,k\in\mathbb N$ with $k\le J$, $I$ a finite raw-incidence set over finite decidable index types, $w$ a wanted label and $u$ a length-variable local-subset prefix. Then

$$u\in\operatorname{frontier}(I,w,k)\iff\exists r\in I:\ \operatorname{wantedOf}(r)=w\ \wedge\ \operatorname{take}_k(\operatorname{word}(r))=u.$$

This states completeness and exact membership of the executed reporting frontier in original raw incidences.
